parsed.explanation: No trader-facing criminal or presentation offence is documented, and sexual-activity law is decriminalised. The dossier records no trans-specific border screening, no visitor-facing birth-sex facility rule, and no custody or emergency-care exclusion. Its large, growing Pride events and a 3,000-person trans march show documented public visibility and acceptance. Downward pressure comes from the facilities friction (17% of discrimination reports in restrooms, only 5 of 149 all-gender toilets meeting standards), a rising anti-gender movement, and an unspecified pending conscription change. The surgery-marker requirement and education/employment protections are resident-facing and were not scored. Visitor-facing service anti-discrimination enforcement is undocumented, and violence data is absent, so the violence axis is treated as undocumented rather than assessed.
